title: SD-card firmware updates for offline field devices

spans.text: Where there is no internet, a technician can carry a firmware file on an SD card and update the device locally. This is useful for laboratory and field equipment.

`SD.h`/`SD_MMC.h` reads the file; the ESP32 `Update` class can write an application partition. A card being present does not make its contents trustworthy: use a signed image built for the exact board, check its manifest/model/version/size, and keep power stable. This short example illustrates the installation flow only; production firmware must verify the image signature before writing.

SD SPI or SD-MMC wiring, pins, and voltage depend on the board. Do not remove the card before the update finishes.

spans.title: Important safety and compatibility note
spans.text: `verifySignedImage` is intentionally project-specific; do not replace it with an always-true stub. A wrong image size or partition can leave the device unable to boot.
